description: [DEEP] Extract repeated validation logic into a private helper method
request: In validator.py, the `validate_email` and `validate_username` functions both contain identical length-check logic (checking `len(value) < 3` and raising ValueError). Extract that repeated check into a private helper function `_check_min_length(value, field_name, min_len=3)` and call it from both validators. The public function signatures must not change.
